notes.title: 2025.8.5 Recent Updates Changelog and Future Plans
notes.content: [h2]2025.8.2[/h2][olist][*][p]Continued optimizing the game, reduced input lag, reduced VRAM and RAM usage[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Sword Danmaku Art being cheesable[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Stage 2 boss having incorrect bullet-firing sounds, and bullet prediction lines being wrong in Stage 1. Also fixed prediction lines sometimes showing up even without Hakurei Mind's Eye of Danmaku equipped[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "Living God" being shown as "Youkai Sage" when leveling up[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed being able to upgrade an item twice by pressing confirm rapidly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some issues with leveling up to a youkai/Living God: Being able to continue, retry, and unlocking items under practice mode[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the ninth pair of shoes being repeated[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed being unable to take off your hat, socks, and accessories[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a collision-related replay desync in Stage 3[/p][/*][*][p]The stage 2 boss' hidden drops are automatically collected to avoid them being lost by accident[/p][/*][*][p]Display important parts of boss' hitboxes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash related to passive clothing abilities[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some replays being unplayable[/p][/*][*][p]Show the version number on screen[/p][/*][*][p]Adjustments to the Merit Value log to prevent text overflow[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some button settings not taking effect[/p][/*][*][p]Continue replacing assets from the original games[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h2]2025.8.3[/h2][olist][*][p]Make it harder to dodge Laser Danmaku Art on the inside[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed getting hit in the tutorial, restarting, and capturing the first spell resulting in a failed capture being displayed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed pre-spawn bullets rendering with the wrong orientation[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some stage 3 boss spells having no damage resistance and thus being trivially bypassable[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash in the settings menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed text overflow in some dialogue boxes[/p][/*][*][p]When holding Z to skip dialogue, also skip dialogue choices. This will not deduct Merit Value.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][h2]2025.8.5[/h2][olist][*][p]Reduce the health of some spell cards so that they're capturable even without understanding the system[/p][/*][*][p]Make scatter-aimed bullets in stage 1 and stage 1 boss static. Refinements to the bullet shapes and fix some sprite issues[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the colors of some of the stage 3 boss' bullets. Some bullets have been changed to the opposite color of your favorite color for better visual distinction[/p][/*][*][p]Remember the last selected difficulty and shot[/p][/*][*][p]Add English translations. Some text may still overflow their boxes, this will be corrected in a later update.[/p][/*][*][p]Prompt the player to pick vocal or Touhou-style music on first start[/p][/*][*][p]Other: "Press C to edit character" no longer shows on Reimu and Marisa, fixed the Medium Orb Shooter's firing angles, fixed being able to continue in spell practice, fixed some typos in image resources[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Future Plans[/h2][p][/p][olist][*][p]Refine the settings UI[/p][/*][/olist][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45700498/20a0b37a4aacc0ed32a899dd2d410356584538c8.png"][/img]2. Continue optimizing the game[/p][p]3. Add more clothing and items[/p][p]4. Complete English translation[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]On behalf of the team, I sincerely thank our dear players for their valuable feedback.[/p][p]We hope to hear more of your opinions and suggestions.[/p][p]You can reach us via the following channels.[/p][olist][*][p]QQ group: 816053495[/p][/*][*][p]Comment on the Steam store page of the demo[/p][/*][*][p]Comment on the following video, or message the video uploader on Bilibili: [url="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1sp83zwEZG"]https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1sp83zwEZG[/url][/p][/*][*][p]Email 1149775512@qq.com[/p][/*][*][p]\[TL note] You may also ping williewillus on YouTube or Discord and he will forward your feedback to the appropriate channels.[/p][/*][/olist][p]Thank you for your support of [i]Categorical Imperative Valid?[/i]![/p][p][/p][p]Games are inextricably tied to the feedback of the players. Once again, we thank the players who have downloaded the demo of Categorical Imperative Valid? and given their feedback.[/p][p] Sakurai Rin (樱景琳)[/p]

notes.title: 2025.7.31 Recent Updates Changelog and Future Plans
notes.content: [p]2025.7.30 Aggregate Changelog[/p][olist][*][p]Defeating any attack of a boss will auto-collect all items on screen[/p][/*][*][p]The player can still move when presented with dialogue choices[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the damage of 13 of the danmaku-firing items[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered the experience requirements for leveling up[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug when you select “default" in the Character Maker[/p][/*][*][p]Attempt to fix a crash when opening the game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a crash when you have no spells equipped in the tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the BGM not unlocking properly[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the saturation of the background to avoid visibility issues[/p][/*][*][p]Allow entering the settings from the pause menu[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]2025.7.31 Aggregate Changelog[/p][olist][*][p]Fixed a crash when reaching Level 20[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the player's Level not being saved properly[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased the pattern difficulty on lower difficulties[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some typographical errors[/p][/*][*][p]Fix some bugs with the makeup setting[/p][/*][*][p]Moved the tutorial in the main menu to avoid mistaken selections[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized the game and decrease VRAM demand[/p][/*][*][p]Changed the Amulet Bullet Shooter item, now it's easier to hit the boss with it[/p][/*][*][p]Added English translation for the omake[/p][/*][*][p]Lowered the opacity of the cherry blossoms in the Stage 2 background to improve visibility[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed replay issues in Stage 3[/p][/*][*][p]The GPU to use is now selectable in the settings. Previous lag could be due to the dedicated GPU not being properly utilized.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed esc+r during a replay not restarting the replay[/p][/*][*][p]Defeating the Stage 3 boss no longer causes the Taking A Life penalty[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]Future Plans:[/p][olist][*][p]Add exclusive fullscreen to lower input lag[/p][/*][*][p]Improve the settings UI[/p][/*][/olist][p]On behalf of the team, I sincerely thank our dear players for their valuable feedback.[/p][p]We hope to hear more of your opinions and suggestions.[/p][p]You can reach us via the following channels.[/p][olist][*][p]QQ group: 816053495  [/p][/*][*][p]Comment on the Steam store page of the demo[/p][/*][*][p]Comment on the following video, or message the video uploader on Bilibili: [url="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1sp83zwEZG"]https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1sp83zwEZG[/url] [/p][/*][*][p]Email [url="https://1149775512@qq.com"]1149775512@qq.com[/url]  [/p][/*][*][p]\[TL note] You may also ping williewillus on YouTube or Discord and he will forward your feedback to the appropriate channels.[/p][/*][/olist][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support of [i]Categorical Imperative Valid?[/i]![/p]
